manifesto.label: 01 · The point
manifesto.copy: Taranity is a digital studio for clients of every size and kind: companies, studios, and individuals with one good idea, anywhere in the world. Whatever the domain, every line of type, every transition, every second of load time is treated as part of the brand.

method.name: Stay
method.line: Launch is the midpoint. We keep it running and improving.

studio.label: 03 · The studio
studio.lede: Small by choice, senior by default.
story: Taranity began with a small irritation: a university schedule portal so slow that building a better one felt like self-defense. The habit stuck. Find the part of the day that wastes human attention, and replace it with something that runs on its own.

Today the studio designs and builds across the whole stack, for clients anywhere in the world. Sites that read like editorials, products that feel inevitable, automation that never calls in sick. The last five percent gets sweated, because that is the part people feel.

principles.title: Outcomes over output
principles.body: Every engagement carries a number it is expected to move.

principles.title: Detail is the product
principles.body: Type, rhythm, and pace are not decoration. They are the brand.

principles.title: Quietly engineered
principles.body: Fast on a phone, kind to a screen reader, private by default.

principles.title: Built to last
principles.body: Still working, still elegant, long after the launch.
